description: The stock universe as committed DATA (previously it lived only in the securities table — not reproducible from the repo). The pipeline reconciles the DB to this file. Foreign coverage is EDGAR-first: SEC 20-F/40-F filers only (public domain, license-clean, IFRS concepts mapped in catalog._CANONICAL); markets with thin ADR coverage are the native-adapter backlog (ESEF, EDINET, SEDAR...). stocks_us is generated by `python -m engine.universescan expand-us` (ranked by dei:EntityPublicFloat via the XBRL frames API); stocks_foreign_auto is generated by `discover-foreign` (all 20-F/40-F filers, assets-ranked, country-classified, capped per market); stocks_foreign is the curated override list. Country names match engine/universe.py.

coverage_gaps.Saudi Arabia: no SEC filers (Aramco/Tadawul are not US-listed) — needs a native adapter
coverage_gaps.Malaysia: no significant SEC filers — needs a native adapter
coverage_gaps.Thailand: FN only (Cayman-incorporated, Thai operations) — thin ADR coverage
coverage_gaps.Hong Kong: thin (most HK-listed majors do not file with the SEC)
coverage_gaps.Germany: thin (Siemens, Allianz, BASF delisted their ADRs) — ESEF adapter closes this
coverage_gaps.Sweden: thin (ERIC/SPOT only) — ESEF adapter closes this
